descricao_original: Spherical cells are also present in tissues. This image shows dorsal root ganglion (DRG) neurons, which are highly specialized to conduct sensory signals into the brain and spinal cord. Each cell possesses a well-defined nucleus and nucleolus within a spherical cell body. DRG neurons are surrounded by small supporting cells (Schwann cells). Dorsal root ganglion 1000x
